Overview

Hobart is a city in Tasmania with a population of 251,047. Tasmania’s historic capital with MONA, Mount Wellington, and a thriving local food and whisky scene. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
